name: How do I choose the best material for my new deck boards?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best material for my new deck boards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the best material depends on your budget, desired aesthetics, maintenance preferences, and expected lifespan. Pressure-treated lumber is economical and durable, while cedar and redwood offer natural beauty with varying degrees of maintenance. Composite decking provides low maintenance and resistance to rot and insects, but at a higher initial cost. Consider factors like sun exposure, moisture levels, and how you use your deck when making your decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider budget, aesthetics, maintenance, and lifespan when choosing materials like pressure-treated lumber, cedar, redwood, or composite.
